plan.title: Surrogate Bid on Live Reverse Auction

steps.note: Open the prepared live auction directly on its Participants tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case setup.
Submit the buyer's ₹95 bid for an eligible vendor on the live auction.
Verify that Procol accepted the surrogate bid submission.
Verify the auction response is present and marked as a surrogate bid.
Open the buyer's comparison grid to inspect the resulting rank.
Verify the surrogate bid participates in reverse-auction ranking.
